title: Canebrake Ecological Reserve
text: Canebrake Ecological Reserve lies in the South Fork Valley, on the north side of Highway 178. Before the state acquired it in 1994, the property was a ranch established around 1872. Its habitat types include valley foothill riparian, blue oak and digger pine, and Joshua tree. Hundreds of bird species occur there, and the cottonwood-willow forest shelters the endangered southwestern willow flycatcher and the state-listed western yellow-billed cuckoo.
